en.title: Dives 600 m and Stays Down an Hour! What Animal Is It?
en.description: The Weddell seal can dive to 600 m and stay underwater for up to an hour. Its whiskers carry more than 500 nerve endings that sense prey in the dark, and it breathes through holes in the Antarctic ice.
